whyDubaiSection.title: Why Start a Business in Dubai?
paragraphs: Dubai has become a global business hub, benefiting from its attractive business environment, tax-free status, and strategic location that links the East to West.
With 100% foreign ownership, zero corporate tax, accelerated visa and license approvals, and all these advantages, thousands of new companies are registered each month.

The city offers unparalleled infrastructure, world-class Free Zones, a reliable and efficient government, and a strong rule of law — making setup straightforward and efficient. Capital and profits can be repatriated freely, and digital government portals make applying easy.

sidebarCard.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a question about Company Formation in Dubai.

items.q: What is the cost to set up a business in Dubai?
items.a: Costs vary by jurisdiction (Free Zone, Mainland, Offshore), license type, and business activities. Free zone formation typically starts from AED 5,750. Mainland businesses incur higher government and local sponsor fees. We offer transparent all-inclusive packages to fit your budget and goals.

items.q: How long will it take to get a trade license in Dubai?
items.a: Free Zone licenses are typically issued in 2-5 working days. Mainland licenses take 2-4 weeks depending on approvals. We fast-track the process for our clients.

items.q: Can foreigners be 100% owners of a company in Dubai?
items.a: Yes. Under recent UAE reforms, most Free Zone and many Mainland activities now allow 100% foreign ownership without a local partner.

items.q: What type of license do I need for my Dubai business?
items.a: It depends on your activity. Commercial (trading), Professional (services), Industrial (manufacturing), or E-Commerce licenses are the main types. We help you choose the right one.

items.q: Do I need an office space to start a business in Dubai?
items.a: Most licenses require a registered address. Free Zones offer flexi-desk packages. Mainland businesses need a physical office (Ejari). We help you find the right space.

items.q: Can I open a corporate bank account in Dubai after incorporating?
items.a: Yes. We provide full support for corporate bank account opening with top UAE banks — documentation, appointments, and follow-ups for quick approvals.

items.q: How many visas can I apply for with my Dubai company?
items.a: Visa quota depends on your license type and office space. Free Zones typically allow 1-6 visas per license, while Mainland allows unlimited visas based on office size.

items.q: How does setting up a company in Dubai benefit me in taxes?
items.a: Dubai offers 0% personal and corporate income tax in Free Zones, and very low corporate tax on Mainland. You can also repatriate 100% of profits and capital.

items.q: Can I start an online business in Dubai?
items.a: Yes. E-Commerce licenses in Free Zones (like IFZA, SHAMS, Dubai CommerCity) allow you to run online businesses with 100% foreign ownership.

items.q: What ongoing compliance is required after setup?
items.a: Annual license renewal, VAT registration (if turnover exceeds AED 375,000), ESR/UBO filings, and bookkeeping. We provide ongoing compliance support.
